name: Cadbury fuse
ingredients_raw: Centre filling 72% - peanuts (19%), sugar, interesterified vegetable fat, liquid glucose, milk solids, hydrogenated vegetable oil, cocoa solids, invert sugar, humectant (422), iodised salt, emulsifiers (322, 471), flavours (nature identical and artificial (vanilla) flavouring substances); milk chocolate 28% - sugar, cocoa butter, milk solids (4%), lactose, cocoa solids, fractionated fat, emulsifiers (442, 476), flavours (natural, nature identical and artificial (vanilla and caramel) flavouring substances).
